intro.text: Time to leave home! E is just above D, so your left middle finger reaches up for it. I sits above K, for your right middle finger.
intro.tip: Reach up, tap, and come straight back to the home row – like a quick hop.

steps.title: Meet E and I
steps.instructions: Press each key as it lights up. The cursor waits for the right key.

steps.title: Guided drill
steps.text: ded kik ded kik eee iii die lie fie hide side
steps.instructions: Reach for the new keys, then return to the home row.

steps.title: Mix it up
steps.instructions: New keys mixed with the ones you already know.

steps.title: Real words
steps.instructions: Every word uses only keys you have learnt.

steps.title: Hands-on challenge
text: she likes a fish dish; his kids feel glad; a leaf falls; she hides a shell; he sees a high hill;
a kid fills a dish; she feels safe; he seeks a field; his idea is ideal; she sells a sea shell;
steps.instructions: The keyboard hints fade out – trust your fingers!
